title: Locally Private Parametric Methods for Change-Point Detection
abstract: arXiv:2602.13619v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study parametric change-point detection under local differential privacy, focusing on the offline localization of a single change point in a sequence of independent observations.~In the non-private setting, we derive improved finite-sample accuracy guarantees for a generalized likelihood-ratio estimator using martingale methods.~We establish finite-sample minimax lower bounds in both the non-private and locally private settings, showing that localization accuracy is fundamentally limited by the Chernoff information between the pre- and post-change distributions.~Guided by this, we design locally private CPD algorithms based on aggregated randomized response and binary mechanisms, which maximize the Chernoff information between the induced output distributions in low- and high-privacy regimes, respectively, and derive their finite-sample guarantees. Together, our upper and lower bounds quantify the statistical cost of privacy

translated_title: 本地隐私保护的变点检测参数化方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究本地差分隐私下的参数化变点检测问题，重点关注对独立观测序列中单一变点的离线定位。在无隐私保护的设定下，我们利用鞅方法为广义似然比估计量推导出改进的有限样本精度保证。我们在无隐私和本地隐私两种设定下均建立了有限样本极小极大下界，表明定位精度从根本上受变点前后分布之间Chernoff信息的限制。受此启发，我们设计了基于聚合随机响应机制和二元机制的本地隐私变点检测算法，这两种算法分别在低隐私和高隐私机制下最大化诱导输出分布之间的Chernoff信息，并推导出其有限样本保证。我们的上下界共同量化了隐私保护所带来的统计代价。
tldr: 本文研究了本地差分隐私下的参数化变点检测问题，建立了以Chernoff信息为根本限制的有限样本极小极大上下界，并据此设计了分别适用于低隐私和高隐私机制的最优本地隐私变点检测算法，从而精确量化了隐私保护带来的统计代价。
